name: Cairo City Break Tour Package
description: Treat yourself to be amazed while try Cairo City Break where you will be able to stare at the Pyramids of Giza, walk-through at the Egyptian Museum and more with Short Breaks to Egypt, amuse your eyes with the ravishing Citadel of Salah el Din and more gleaming finds of Egypt Short Tours you will explore with Cairo Short Breaks
overview: Treat yourself to be amazed while try Cairo City Break where you will be able to stare at the Pyramids of Giza, walk-through at the Egyptian Museum and more with Short Breaks to Egypt, amuse your eyes with the ravishing Citadel of Salah el Din and more gleaming finds of Egypt Short Tours you will explore with Cairo Short Breaks

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Cairo airport, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will escort you to Pyramids of Giza and the Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinus, proceed to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, lunch will be served at local restaurant, continue your tour by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, next round will be to Old Cairo including visits to the various Churches there ( Visit maximum 02 churches ), visit Ben Ezra Synagogue, enjoy your lunch at an oriental restaurant at the end of your day tour back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure.

inclusions: Meet at Cairo International Airport plus transfer to hotel by air-conditioned modern vehicle
Accommodation for 02 Nights in Cairo including Breakfast and all taxes
One day excursion in Cairo as mentioned in the above itinerary
One Lunch at an oriental restaurant in Cairo
A bottle of Mineral Water to each person
English speaking guide at Cairo excursion
Entrance fees to the above-mentioned sites as mentioned in the above itinerary
Transfers in Cairo by air-conditioned vehicle
Transfer to Cairo International airport for final departure.
exclusions: Supplement cost for the Grand Egyptian Museum instead of the Old Egyptian Museum: USD 25 per person
Entrance inside any of the pyramids will be with extra fees (Tickets can be booked on the Spot) -1st Great Pyramids: 35.00 USD$ - 2nd Pyramids OR 3rd Pyramid: 15.00 USD$
Optional tours not mentioned at the above itinerary
